title: Ramp API — Docs, Pricing & OpenAPI | APIs.io
snippet:
Ramp is a finance automation platform that combines corporate cards, expense management, accounts payable, vendor management, and accounting integrations into a single product. The Ramp Developer API enables developers to access and manage Ramp account data, build applications for the Ramp App Center reaching over 25,000 Ramp customers, and automate financial workflows by integrating Ramp into existing systems.

Ramp’s developer surface includes authentication, documentation, signup flow, pricing, engineering blog, support, and 43 more developer resources.
**Pull Ramp's APIs, OpenAPI, scores and pricing into your own code or AI agent** with a free APIs.io key — sign in with [GitHub](https://apis.io/api/v1/auth/login?provider=github), [Google](https://apis.io/api/v1/auth/login?provider=google) or [LinkedIn](https://apis.io/api/v1/auth/login?provider=linkedin). No form to fill in; signing in shares your email address with us ([Privacy](https://apis.io/privacy/)).

Prices published by Ramp, read 2026-10-28 from [ramp.com/pricing](https://ramp.com/pricing).
| Plan | Price |
|---|---|
| Free | $0/mo/user Includes: Corporate card, travel & expense, AP, AR, banking, basic accounting rules, QuickBooks Online and Xer |
| Plus | $15/mo/user + Platform fee based on team size Includes: All the features of Free, plus AI-driven automation; Save 20% with annual billing |
| Enterprise | Custom Includes: All the features of Plus, and custom integrations, white glove support; Annual billing |
### Rate limits
- Free Tier Default: 10 requests per minute
- Free Tier Monthly Quota: 1000 requests per month
- Professional Tier Default: 100 requests per minute
Compiled by API Evangelist, not yet checked against Ramp's documentation. [All 5 limits →](https://apis.io/rate-limits/ramp/ramp-rate-limits/)
**Billed by:** user · [FinOps profile →](https://apis.io/finops/ramp/ramp-finops/)

### How much does the Ramp API cost?
Ramp publishes its prices; its Free plan is $0/mo/user as of 2026-10-28. APIs.io lists 3 pricing plans for Ramp, with each plan's price, limits and inclusions under Pricing on this page.

Ramp has a Kin Score of 53.3 out of 100 (developing) and an Agent Readiness score of 39.8 (agent-ready), scored by API Evangelist on 2026-11-21.

Calls without `X-API-Key` need no key. Calls with it need a paid plan — [get a key](https://apis.io/developer/account/?access=1).

snippet:
| Pricing | Freemium ($15 / seat-mo) · No separate API fee is published. ramp.com/pricing lists Free at $0 per user per month, Plus at $15 per user per month plus a platform fee by team size, and Enterprise on request, with a 30-day Plus trial. The OpenAPI spec marks 51 of 260 operations as needing Plus. Access needs an approved Ramp business account, so an agent can't start without one. A sandbox at demo-api.ramp.com is available on request through a form. The API Agreement reserves the right to charge API fees (checked 2026-10-08).

- Payments & pricing 25: Read with the hosted rubric. Ramp's API isn't paid for by x402, MPP or L402. Ramp does let an agent pay other sellers by x402 from a funded wallet or by Stripe MPP, which is a product capability and not a way to buy access (0). Plan prices are public, Free at $0 per user per month and Plus at $15 per user per month plus a platform fee by team size that isn't stated, with Enterprise on request. The API has no per-call price (10). The Free plan needs no payment card, but it needs an approved Ramp business account, and sandbox access is by request form, so partial credit (15 of 20). The Developer MCP server answers docs questions with no account. Account data needs an admin to create an app in the dashboard or a person to complete an OAuth sign-in (0).

- unchecked: whether the Free plan includes Developer API access. The spec marks 209 operations as not needing Plus, and the pricing page doesn't list the API under any plan
